# laravelforge_site_deploy_script (Data Source)

Fetches the deployment script of a Laravel Forge site.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `organization` (String) Organization slug.
- `server_id` (Number) ID of the server the site belongs to.
- `site_id` (Number) ID of the site whose deployment script is fetched.

### Read-Only

- `auto_source` (Boolean) Make `.env` variables available to the deployment script.
- `content` (String) The content of the deployment script.
